title: Projection transport along a right adjoint comparison
statement: Let J:C→D be left adjoint to Q:D→C [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection], between monoidal categories [def-sfb-monoidal-category]. Let U:D→C be strong monoidal [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor] and s:U≅Q. If the mixed tensor comparison δ(QM,UH) is s(M)⁻¹⊗1 followed by μ(U;M,H) then s(M⊗H), the projection for the adjunction transported from Q to U agrees with the original mixed projection at every pair (M,H).

source.place: last paragraph: projection formula on chosen compactifications and the ordered affine-line tower; categorical calculations making coefficient normalization explicit

proof.text:
express both projection components as inverse Hom transposes. For the
transported adjunction its unit is the original unit followed by the inverse right
comparison. Its inverse Hom transpose appends the forward right comparison. Tensor
bifunctoriality therefore gives exactly the mixed comparison in the statement.

theorem tensorProjection_ofNatIsoRight
    {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    [MonoidalCategory C] [MonoidalCategory D]
    {J : C ⥤ D} {Q U : D ⥤ C} (adj : J ⊣ Q) [U.Monoidal]
    (s : U ≅ Q)
    (δ : (((Functor.whiskeringLeft₂ C).obj Q).obj U).obj (curriedTensor C) ⟶
      (Functor.postcompose₂.obj Q).obj (curriedTensor D))
    (hδ : ∀ M H : D, (δ.app M).app H =
      s.inv.app M ▷ U.obj H ≫ Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ U M H ≫ s.hom.app (M ⊗ H))
    (M : C) (H : D) :
    (((adj.ofNatIsoRight s.symm).projectionMap U (curriedTensor C) (curriedTensor D)
      (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μNatTrans U)).app M).app H =
      ((adj.projectionMap U (curriedTensor C) (curriedTensor D) δ).app M).app H
